title: abies canadensis
intro: Abies canadensis, commonly known as Eastern White Pine, is a large evergreen coniferous tree native to eastern North America. The health benefits of Eastern White Pine include its potential to reduce inflammation and relieve respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to calm the nervous system, promote relaxation, and relieve muscle spasms, which is attributed to its bioactive constituents, including terpenes and flavonoids. The bioactive constituents of Eastern White Pine include alpha-pinene, beta-pinene, and limonene, which contribute to its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties.
